limits: This batch covers only one recruitment group; it does not establish corpus-wide generalization or independence.
Several histories use the clear closed-issue then current-request structure. Broader corpus review must assess repeated scaffolding and language diversity across groups.
Benchmark exclusions and cross-split lexical/semantic checks remain mandatory before dataset acceptance.
Approval is initial message quality only and does not accept the corpus for training.
